60 SF bathroom remodel, unchanged fixture locations

Remodel one 6 by 10 foot bathroom, 60 SF, in Boise, Idaho. Existing fixture locations stay unchanged. Remove existing finishes and fixtures. Supply and install 60 SF porcelain floor tile, 84 SF shower wall tile with waterproofing, one 30-inch vanity, one integrated vanity top and sink, one faucet, one toilet, one shower valve and trim, one shower pan, and one framed shower door. Paint 120 SF of non-tiled walls and 60 SF ceiling. Mid-range materials. Include normal plumbing reconnections, demolition disposal, installation supplies, protection and cleanup. Ground-floor normal access, unoccupied room. No structural work, electrical changes, whole-home work, concealed damage remediation or whole-house plumbing. Exclude permit fees and design. Shower footprint is 3 by 4 feet; shower walls are 7 feet high with 12 LF of tiled wall perimeter.
